name: Дробовик Сайга-12К

visualReview.method: Assistant visual inspection of production renderer contact crops and player/NPC scenes; not user sign-off.
visualReview.coverage: Root inspected suits 1–48 and the screenshot pair 19. Independent reviewer inspected suits 49–96, including all 48 full player/NPC scenes. Native-arm exceptions 56/62 and corrections 58/67/91/96 received targeted additional review. The final render changes only pairs 58/67/91/96 from the previously reviewed candidate; all other per-pair fingerprints, source images and renderer code are unchanged.
checks: Index finger contacts the trigger opening
Supporting palm contacts the fore-end instead of floating beside the magazine
Continuous stock connection without detached rear slivers
One unchanged transparent shared weapon PNG

mirrorNote: Draw and clip geometry is mirrored within 1/1024 screen pixel. Antialiasing produces small raster differences, so byte-identical reflection is not claimed.
